essenceodyssey.tips.author_gold: Tips from the author are gold!
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_bookmark: Press A on an ingredient to bookmark it.
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_search_mod: Prefix a search with @ to search items by mod.
essenceodyssey.tips.jei_search_tag: Prefix a search with # to search items by tag — but remember to drop the namespace.
essenceodyssey.tips.nuclear_easy: This one is a Chinese joke — sorry, it doesn't survive translation.
essenceodyssey.tips.bee_fbi: Bees have child-protection laws too! Try breeding two baby bees in a breeding chamber and you'll summon the F. Bee I.!
essenceodyssey.tips.2: You can add a spacer to the Cogwheel by right-clicking the Cogwheel with the Andesite Casing. — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.4: The author's tip is golden. — lvhuana
essenceodyssey.tips.5: Go mooch some free rice off the user! — Cobalt Blue
essenceodyssey.tips.6: Who wouldn't want a silly winefox that eats for free? — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.7: I've checked in today. I'm waiting for you~ [This message type is not supported yet. Please view it on mobile QQ.] — cabbage_of_67
essenceodyssey.tips.lilypad: Bonemeal a Starlit Lily Pad to bring it back into bloom.
essenceodyssey.tips.ancient_sapling: Sniffers can sometimes dig up an Ashen Sapling.
essenceodyssey.info.steel_block: JEI only shows the IE steel block, but Mekanism's works too.
essenceodyssey.info.steel_block.detail: When building Immersive Engineering multiblocks, JEI only lists the IE steel block, but Mekanism's works too.
essenceodyssey.tips.lock: Items that Eternal Starlight has not implemented yet show a lock icon in the upper-left corner of their slot.
essenceodyssey.info.aerogel.detail: Formed by placing lava in the Aether.
essenceodyssey.info.aersmog.detail: Formed where water and poison meet.
essenceodyssey.info.mysterious_cube.deta: No tool you have can break the mysterious block in the meteorite. The notebook may have mentioned it, go look for clues.
essenceodyssey.info.starcore_light.detai: Right-click a Block of Blazing Starcore with any pickaxe to turn it into a brighter Starcore Light.
essenceodyssey.info.blazing_starcore_blo: Place a Block of Starcore near lava (a fluid source) and it will turn into a Block of Blazing Starcore.
essenceodyssey.tips.team_quest: There is a team button in the upper-left corner of the inventory screen, where you can set up your team and share quest progress with teammates!
essenceodyssey.tips.immersive_technology: We don't have Immersive Technology for MC 1.21.1 — but maybe one day we will, who knows?
essenceodyssey.tips.create_aeronautics: Sorry, no flying-sofa stunts here: Create: Aeronautics isn't installed.
essenceodyssey.tips.fusion_reactor: Did you know you can start a Fusion Reactor with wood?
essenceodyssey.tips.member_colorful: Tips from group members may be colorful — don't take them all as truth!
essenceodyssey.tips.alt_and_f4: Press Alt + F4 to activate cheat mode! — Wait, if you do, the author takes no responsibility for the consequences.
essenceodyssey.tips.tertiary_aspect: The author once considered tertiary aspects, but gave up in the end — too many recipes.
essenceodyssey.tips.11: The future is bright and promising! — Cobalt Blue
essenceodyssey.tips.12: Pour a bucket of lava in front of the Encased Fan, and it will blow hot air! But what's the point...? — XiaoY
essenceodyssey.tips.13: Dusted Gravel is a variant of Gravel. Mining it has a chance to drop a Dusted Shard — a variant of Flint. — Mysterious Author
essenceodyssey.tips.14: When you read me, you read me. — Tips
essenceodyssey.tips.26: If you spend 60 s playing the game, you would spend 1 min in real life! — fish
essenceodyssey.info.unknown_mixture.deta: You have no idea how it came to be, and JEI shows no trace of it. The notebook may have mentioned it, go look for clues.
essenceodyssey.info.paradox_collapser.de: You have no idea how it came to be, and JEI shows no trace of it. The notebook may have mentioned it, go look for clues.

essenceodyssey.tips.18: This world is more complex than the original one — That's true
